short.en: Major incident detection: spots bursts of similar tickets in real time and lets the service desk handle them as one incident.
short.fr: Détection des incidents majeurs : repère en temps réel les afflux de tickets similaires et permet de les traiter comme un seul incident.
short.de: Erkennung von Major Incidents: erkennt Häufungen ähnlicher Tickets in Echtzeit und bearbeitet sie als einen Vorfall.
short.es: Detección de incidentes mayores: detecta en tiempo real ráfagas de tickets similares y permite gestionarlas como un solo incidente.
short.pt: Detecção de incidentes graves: identifica em tempo real picos de chamados semelhantes e permite tratá-los como um único incidente.
short.tr: Büyük olay tespiti: kısa sürede gelen benzer kayıtları anında yakalar, tek bir olay olarak yönetmenizi sağlar.

long.en:
When something breaks, the service desk receives the same complaint dozens of times in a few minutes. Surge recognises these bursts as they happen (text similarity with diacritic folding, stemming and TF-IDF, optional local embeddings) and groups them into one surge.
* One click: master ticket or problem with every ticket linked; late tickets are linked automatically * One public follow-up to every requester; solving the master solves all linked tickets * Notice on the self-service portal ("We are aware of the mail outage") so users stop opening duplicates * E-mail to fixed recipients and to whoever is on call (built-in on-call rota); webhooks to Slack / Teams * Statistics: time to detect, tickets absorbed, top categories * Detection rules with a dry-run test; banner on every ticket of a surge * No external service required; English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Turkish
